She lost her father to cancer at one, dropped out after Class 10 and was married at 19. Now she earns ₹50 lakh a year - and trains 15,000 farmers for free.

Rubi Pareek grew up in Rajasthan, raised by her widowed mother alongside five siblings after losing her father to cancer at age one. Forced to drop out of school after Class 10 and married at 19, she took over her family's 12-acre chemical-based farm. In 2006, a team from the Krishi Vigyan Kendra in Dausa introduced her to organic farming - she converted the entire farm despite initial resistance. Today her 10-acre operation earns roughly ₹50 lakh annually selling vermicompost and Azolla fern and she has trained over 15,000 farmers for free.
